title: Tiny feature
description: The cheap tier: one Haiku sweep, a short orchestrator plan, Sonnet implementation at medium effort, and the mandatory review gate with a single fix iteration. Same shape as the implementation plan with every dial turned down.
when_to_use: A small, self-contained change with real branching but no design question: one new helper and its tests, a narrow bug fix, a validation rule. Not a rename or one-liner, which need no plan at all.

orchestrator.mandate: Keep the plan short and delegate the code. On a task this small the orchestrator's job is to state the edge cases and then stay out of the way.

nodes.name: codebase-scout
nodes.description: Finds where the change belongs and which existing helper or test pattern to follow, and returns paths rather than file contents.
nodes.produces: Target file, the nearest existing pattern to imitate, and the test file to extend.

nodes.name: implementation-plan
nodes.description: The orchestrator names the target files, the signature, and the edge cases the tests must cover, then gets explicit approval before any code is written.
nodes.produces: Approved plan: signature, behavior, and the edge case list.

nodes.name: implementer
nodes.description: Writes the change and one test per edge case in the approved plan, then runs the targeted tests until clean. Reports back rather than dispatching if it needs a lookup it was not briefed on.
nodes.produces: Working diff, tests, and the test output.

nodes.name: change-reviewer
nodes.description: Reviews the diff for correctness and test quality, anchoring each finding to a file:line, and checks that every edge case in the approved plan is actually covered by a test that could fail. Review-only.
nodes.produces: Findings by severity with file:line anchors, or an explicit all-clear.

feedback.when: the review reports a Bug-severity finding or a missing edge case test
